description: Evaluates the ability to reverse-engineer and implement a path tracing renderer in C by analyzing a reference image and recreating it algorithmically.

name: path-tracing-reverse
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to reverse-engineer a compiled path tracing renderer and recreate functionally identical C source code under size constraints.

name: polyglot-c-py
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Create a single polyglot source file that computes Fibonacci numbers when executed as both Python 3 and C code.

name: polyglot-rust-c
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to write a polyglot program that compiles and runs correctly as both Rust and C++ code, computing Fibonacci numbers.

name: portfolio-optimization
author: Yanhao Li
description: Evaluates the ability to implement a high-performance C extension for Python that performs portfolio risk and return calculations at least 1.2x faster than a pure Python baseline while maintaining numerical accuracy.

name: protein-assembly
author: Karl Krauth
description: Evaluates the ability to design a fusion protein gBlock by querying bioinformatics APIs, selecting proteins based on spectral properties, and applying codon optimization with GC content constraints.

name: prove-plus-comm
author: TheMikeMerrill
description: Evaluates the ability to complete an incomplete Coq proof of addition commutativity using inductive reasoning and formal verification tactics.

name: pypi-server
author: Anurag Kashyap
description: Evaluates the ability to create a Python package, build it, set up a local PyPI server, and make the package installable from the server.

name: pytorch-model-cli
author: Jan-Lucas Uslu
description: Evaluates the ability to convert PyTorch model weights to JSON, implement neural network inference in C, and create a command-line tool for MNIST digit prediction.

name: pytorch-model-recovery
author: Akshay Anand
description: Evaluates the ability to reverse-engineer a PyTorch Transformer model architecture from a state dictionary, load pre-trained weights, and selectively fine-tune specific layers to improve performance on a dataset.

name: qemu-alpine-ssh
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to start an Alpine Linux VM in QEMU and configure SSH server access with proper networking and authentication.

name: qemu-startup
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to configure and start a QEMU virtual machine with telnet-accessible serial console, requiring knowledge of QEMU command-line options, network configuration, and system readiness verification.

name: query-optimize
author: Shreyas Pimpalgaonkar
description: Evaluates the ability to optimize a slow SQL query with correlated subqueries by rewriting it using CTEs and window functions while preserving exact output.

name: raman-fitting
author: Jan-Lucas Uslu
description: Evaluates the ability to fit Lorentzian curves to Raman spectroscopy data, extract peak parameters, and perform scientific data analysis using Python.

name: regex-chess
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to implement a complete chess move generator using only regular expression transformations on FEN notation.

name: regex-log
author: Orfeas Menis Mastromichalakis
description: Tests the ability to construct a complex regular expression that matches dates in log lines containing valid IPv4 addresses while handling edge cases and boundary conditions.

name: reshard-c4-data
author: jeffreywpli / dwahdany
description: Evaluates the ability to create Python scripts for bidirectional data resharding with file size and directory constraints, using proper dependency management.

name: rstan-to-pystan
author: Zhiwei Xu
description: Evaluates the ability to convert an RStan Gaussian Process script to functionally equivalent PyStan 3.10.0 code, including complex installation, hyperparameter mapping, and numerical verification of posterior estimates.

name: sam-cell-seg
author: Gabriel Dreiman
description: Evaluates the ability to implement a histopathology image segmentation pipeline using MobileSAM to convert rectangular cell masks to precise polyline contours.

name: sanitize-git-repo
author: jeffreywpli
description: Evaluates the ability to identify and sanitize sensitive API keys and tokens from a Git repository by replacing them with placeholders without modifying unrelated files.

name: schemelike-metacircular-eval
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to implement a metacircular evaluator in Scheme that can interpret itself and a comprehensive suite of Scheme programs.

name: sparql-university
author: Orfeas Menis Mastromichalakis
description: Evaluates the ability to write complex SPARQL queries with multiple constraints, aggregations, and date filtering against an RDF knowledge graph.

name: sqlite-db-truncate
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the ability to recover data from a corrupted SQLite database using binary file analysis and data recovery techniques.

name: sqlite-with-gcov
author: Mike Merrill
description: Evaluates the ability to compile SQLite from source with gcov instrumentation and make it available in the system PATH.

name: torch-pipeline-parallelism
author: Eric Wang
description: Evaluates the ability to implement pipeline parallel training for LLaMA using PyTorch distributed primitives with all-forward-all-backward scheduling.

name: torch-tensor-parallelism
author: Eric Wang
description: Evaluates the ability to implement tensor parallelism for PyTorch linear layers with correct weight sharding, distributed forward/backward passes, and gradient computation across multiple processes.

name: train-fasttext
author: jeffreywpli
description: Train a FastText text classification model on Yelp review data that achieves >0.62 accuracy while staying under 150MB in size.

name: tune-mjcf
author: Zizhao Chen
description: Evaluates the ability to optimize MuJoCo physics simulation parameters to achieve a 40% speedup while maintaining physical accuracy within specified tolerances.

name: video-processing
author: Ivan Bercovich
description: Evaluates the ability to build a computer vision script that analyzes hurdle jump videos and extracts takeoff/landing frame numbers using OpenCV.

name: vulnerable-secret
author: Justin Bauer
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to analyze a binary executable, identify and exploit a buffer overflow vulnerability to bypass authentication, and extract a hidden secret flag.

name: winning-avg-corewars
author: Jeong Shin
description: Evaluates the ability to write a competitive CoreWars Redcode warrior that achieves specific win rates against five diverse opponent strategies.

name: write-compressor
author: Nicholas Carlini
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to reverse-engineer a custom compression format and write a compatible compressor program.
